newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CRICKET-NSW PROSPER DESPITE SLATER FAILURE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-NSW PROSPER DESPITE SLATER FAILURE.

text.p: New South Wales opener Michael Slater's hopes of regaining his place in the Australian side took another knock on Friday when he was dismissed cheaply in a Sheffield Shield match to extend a miserable run of form.

Slater, who has struggled for runs since he was dropped last year at the start of the current test series against West Indies, was bowled by South Australia paceman Shane George for three on the first day of the four-day match in Adelaide.
New South Wales were 282 for five at the close, Corey Richards hitting 76.
In Perth, Rohan Larkin posted his second Sheffield Shield century to guide Victoria to 322 for nine against Western Australia on the opening day of their day-night match.
Larkin showed great concentration in temperatures nearing 40 degrees Celsius to score 104.
